svg.title: Release subprocess and atomic rollback
svg.desc: Repository tag and assets, verified staging, process-isolated apply, atomic PWA promotion, post-switch health, last-known-good state, and rollback.

a.xlink:title: Installed release and runtime state. Stores installed-release identity and release-runtime projection for truthful comparison, staging, apply, rollback, and last-known-good state.
GitHub repository. Hosts source and release workflow definitions; it is not a Lite runtime apply owner.
a.text: definitions; it is not a Lite...

a.xlink:title: GitHub Release. Publishes the verified Lite release manifest, checksums, and dist.zip assets for the release subprocess.
Date-based Lite tag, dist.zip, checksums, and release manifest. Defines immutable release identity and the exact assets required for a Lite installation.
a.text: and the exact assets required for...

a.xlink:title: Download staging and release verification. Downloads on explicit/manual or stable cadence, verifies repository/tag/manifest/assets/checksums, and stages without touching the active PWA.
Release subprocess. Owns network, download, verification, staging, apply, and rollback work outside the FastAPI event loop.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
Atomic PWA promotion. Promotes a verified staged PWA atomically and keeps the previous release available for rollback.
Post-switch health validation. Validates Caddy/FastAPI/PWA health after promotion before declaring the release current.
Last-known-good state and rollback. Records the verified prior release and restores it atomically when post-switch validation fails.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
